description.narrative: The project is expected to i) increase access to credit and alternative financing options for startups (Series A and beyond) in India and (ii) support market creation by supporting an established Fund Manager scale its venture debt investing business model. The fund will strengthen the competitiveness of this asset class and contribute to formalizing the asset class in India. At the market level, the Project is expected to demonstrate commercial viability of the venture debt fund model in the segment, attracting international institutional investors and encourage other fund managers to raise new or follow-on funds, inducing expansion of the venture debt market, beyond the Fund

The proposed Project is an equity investment of up to US$25 million in INR equivalent in Trifecta Venture Debt Fund IV (the Fund), an India domiciled venture debt fund licensed with Securities Exchange Board of India. The Fund is managed by Trifecta Capital VDF Management LLP (the Fund Manager), an Indian limited liability partnership. The Fund will invest in high-growth, early stage and beyond companies across sectors such as technology, climate (energy and mobility), health, agritech, financial services, and consumer services in India.
